feat(api): migrate Inngest to v4

v4 removes `EventSchemas` entirely, so `import { EventSchemas } from 'inngest'`
was a runtime-breaking import once the lockfile was regenerated and v4 was
actually installed.

- client: replace `EventSchemas().fromRecord<Events>()` with per-event
  `eventType(name, { schema: staticSchema<T>() })` definitions exported as
  `EVENTS`. `staticSchema` gives compile-time typing without pulling in a
  runtime validation library, matching the previous behaviour.
- functions: `createFunction` is now 2-arity with the trigger moved into
  options - `triggers: [EVENTS.x]` for event triggers and
  `triggers: [cron(expr)]` for scheduled ones.
- sends: use `EVENTS.x.create(data, { id, ts })`, which restores the
  compile-time payload typing that `fromRecord` used to provide; plain
  `send({ name, data })` payloads are untyped in v4.

Function ids, event names, idempotency keys and send/trigger counts are all
unchanged (11 createFunction, 17 send), so in-flight jobs are unaffected.

fix: repair typecheck, build and lint across the workspace

Build:
- dash: annotate useSession return type; the inferred type referenced
  QueryObserverResult from a duplicated @tanstack/query-core copy, which
  TypeScript cannot name portably. Also drops an unused direct pin.

Typecheck:
- drop deprecated baseUrl/downlevelIteration (removed in TS7); paths are
  already relative to each tsconfig
- raycast: add DOM libs for fetch/URL/timer globals
- extension: declare chrome types explicitly; narrow chrome.storage reads
  now that @types/chrome returns unknown-valued records
- mcp-apps: declare side-effect CSS module imports
- api: pin inngest to ^3.54.2; v4 removes EventSchemas entirely and moves
  triggers into createFunction options, which needs a real migration

Lint:
- pin eslint to ^9.39.4 and @eslint/js to ^9.39.5: no released
  eslint-plugin-react supports eslint 10 (7.37.5 peers cap at ^9.7)
- raycast: migrate .eslintrc.json to flat eslint.config.js

fix(deps): raise happy-dom floor to ^20.8.8 (CVE-2026-33943)

The previous `^20.0.11` floor still permitted the vulnerable `<=20.8.7`
range (ECMAScriptModuleCompiler code-injection RCE, GHSA-6q6h-j7hj-3r64,
fixed in 20.8.8). The lockfile already resolved to a patched 20.10.6, so we
were not exposed at runtime, but the declared floor did not guarantee it.

Raised blurr, logger, and postbridge (all carried the same floor) to
`^20.8.8`; resolution is unchanged (still 20.10.6).

chore(ci): add Dependabot configuration

Weekly grouped npm + github-actions updates so dependencies stop drifting.
Minor/patch updates are grouped to reduce PR noise across the 33 workspaces;
majors arrive as individual PRs for review.

fix(security): pin JWT verify algorithms and harden production secret guard

- token.service.ts: pass algorithms: ['HS256'] to the four jwt.verify calls
  that omitted it (invite, recording-link, session, upload tokens), closing an
  algorithm-confusion gap. Matches the already-hardened sibling verifies.
- env validation: production startup now fails closed when INTERNAL_API_KEY is
  empty, and when GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID is set without GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET (a
  half-configured OAuth path).

chore(deps): patch security advisories and refresh in-range dependencies

Resolves the bulk of `bun audit` findings (58 vulnerable packages -> 4
dev-only residuals). Highlights:

- better-auth / @better-auth/oauth-provider 1.6.9 -> 1.6.19
- inngest 3.51.0 -> 3.54.2 (fixes CVE-2026-42047 / GHSA-2jf5-6wwv-vhxx:
  env-var leak via the serve() PATCH/OPTIONS/DELETE responses)
- @hono/node-server -> 1.19.14 (high: static-path auth bypass)
- happy-dom 15 -> 20 in logger/postbridge (critical: VM context escape RCE)
- next pins -> 16.2.9; apps/home vite 7.3.3 -> 7.3.5 (was a vulnerable exact pin)
- root overrides for transitive vulns: vite (the override itself was pinned to a
  vulnerable 7.3.3), next, qs, postcss, yaml, tar, tmp, shell-quote (critical),
  serialize-javascript

Adapts code to breaking type changes from the bumps so each commit stays green:
- @userplane/auth: PermissionMap interface -> type alias so better-auth's
  newRole() accepts it (its Statements type now requires an index signature)
- apps/api: @unkey/api 2.4 listKeys() returns a PageIterator; read
  response.result.data instead of response.data
- apps/dash: admin plan props use the canonical AdminPlanProduct contract type
  instead of a fragile inferred type that collapsed to 'never'

Remaining residuals (esbuild, js-yaml, minimatch, uuid) are dev/build-only
DoS-class advisories that span major lines, so a global override would downgrade
healthy newer consumers; left for Dependabot to pick up upstream fixes.
